queries.q: What causes rice yield loss in Myanmar?
queries.verdict: Useful: problem records for losses (post-harvest, flood, conflict, pests, yield gap) ranked first

queries.q: Show studies about labor shortages after 2015
queries.verdict: Useful: establishment-method, mechanization and wage studies; year filter applied

queries.q: Find research that actually reached farmers
queries.verdict: Useful: evidence linked to at-scale interventions (dams, combine services, MADB credit) ranks first

queries.q: Show proposed solutions that never scaled
queries.verdict: Useful: the three D-status interventions (rodent management, index insurance, Rice Crop Manager)

queries.q: What datasets can measure rainfall and rice yield?
queries.verdict: Useful: PSD, CHIRPS, FAOSTAT, MAPS

queries.q: Show studies using Sentinel or Landsat
queries.verdict: Useful: 16 remote-sensing studies, Sentinel-1 national mapping first

queries.q: Find research in Ayeyarwady
queries.verdict: Useful: region filter applied; Delta problems, interventions and 72 studies

queries.q: Show monthly datasets related to rice agriculture
queries.verdict: Useful: 10 monthly datasets (prices, rainfall, reanalysis, water, trade)

queries.q: Find optimization studies
queries.verdict: Partly useful: genuine optimization studies are few (insurance contract, drying, harvesting); corpus gap, not a search failure

queries.q: How has Vietnam reduced rice production labor?
queries.verdict: Useful but ranking imperfect: mDSR and combine-diffusion cases appear in top 6 after two Vietnam studies

queries.q: What interventions from Thailand may transfer to Myanmar?
queries.verdict: Useful: both Thai cases with transferability ratings

queries.q: Show high-impact problems with good data availability
queries.verdict: Useful: P01, P02, P04, P05 lead

queries.q: Find research gaps suitable for a data science project
queries.verdict: Useful: flood-loss monitoring, nutrient-tool implementation gap, seeding services, optimum N

queries.q: Which project can save farmer time or labor?
queries.verdict: Useful: crop-establishment model (PR04) first

queries.q: Show studies with quantitative yield effects
queries.verdict: Useful: studies with extracted effect sizes ranked first

queries.q: Show conflicting research about fertilizer
queries.verdict: Useful: S090 vs S158 disagreement on fertilizer levels surfaces first; few true contradictions exist in the corpus

queries.q: Which studies use the same dataset?
queries.verdict: Useful: datasets ranked by number of studies (MAPS used by most)

queries.q: What research has the strongest implementation evidence?
queries.verdict: Useful: at-scale interventions (mechanization services, MADB credit) first

queries.q: mechanization
queries.verdict: Exact term search works

queries.q: mechanisation Myanmar
queries.verdict: British spelling normalised

queries.q: fertiliser optimisaton
queries.verdict: Typo corrected on whole words (optimisaton → optimization) + British spelling tolerated

checks.t: Search + multiple filters (flood + Study + Ayeyarwady + High confidence + 2018-2026) returns 21 studies, all within the year range; active-filter chips and Clear all work
All 11 views render without JavaScript errors in headless Chromium (desktop 1440 px)
Link check: 354 of 354 study and dataset links resolved (HTTP 2xx/3xx; DOIs redirect from doi.org) on 2026-10-09
UI audit 2026-10-09: 72-test Playwright regression suite (layout geometry at 14 viewport sizes, dialogs, history, search, filters, contrast) passes; 53 of these fail on the pre-audit build.
